A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

input.query: SELECT c.service_name, c.span_name, c.attr_http_response_status_code sc, c.attr_status_code, count(*) n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) ms, round(max(c.duration)/1e6,1) max_ms, count(DISTINCT c.trace_id) traces FROM abnormal_traces c WHERE c.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND c.attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT 'a' p, c.span_name cname, s.service_name callee, s.span_name sname, count(*) n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) client_ms, round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) server_ms, sum(CASE WHEN s.attr_http_response_status_code=405 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n405 FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces s ON s.parent_span_id=c.span_id AND s.trace_id=c.trace_id WHERE c.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND c.attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'n' p, c.span_name, s.service_name, s.span_name, count(*), round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1), round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1), 0 FROM normal_traces c JOIN normal_traces s ON s.parent_span_id=c.span_id AND s.trace_id=c.trace_id WHERE c.service_name='ts-preserve-service' AND c.attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT 'a' p, c.service_name caller, c.span_name cname, s.service_name callee, s.span_name sname, count(*) n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) client_ms, round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) server_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces s ON s.parent_span_id=c.span_id AND s.trace_id=c.trace_id WHERE c.service_name IN ('ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-contacts-service','ts-ui-dashboard') AND c.attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'n' p, c.service_name, c.span_name, s.service_name, s.span_name, count(*), round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1), round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) FROM normal_traces c JOIN normal_traces s ON s.parent_span_id=c.span_id AND s.trace_id=c.trace_id WHERE c.service_name IN ('ts-travel-service','ts-travel2-service','ts-contacts-service','ts-ui-dashboard') AND c.attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1
SELECT metric, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT service_name) svcs FROM (SELECT 'nm' t,* FROM normal_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'am',* FROM abnormal_metrics) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'a_restarts' k, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, max(value) mx, min(value) mn FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric='k8s.container.restarts' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'n_restarts', attr_k8s_pod_name, max(value), min(value) FROM normal_metrics WHERE metric='k8s.container.restarts' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'a_sum_'||metric, attr_k8s_pod_name, max(value), min(value) FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric NOT LIKE 'hubble%' AND metric LIKE '%uptime%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'nm' t, metric, count(*) c, min(time)::VARCHAR t0 FROM normal_metrics WHERE attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-ticket-office%' AND metric='k8s.container.restarts' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'am', metric, count(*), min(time)::VARCHAR FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-ticket-office%' AND metric IN ('k8s.container.restarts','k8s.container.ready') GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'al', service_name, count(*), min(time)::VARCHAR FROM abnormal_logs WHERE service_name LIKE '%ticket%' OR attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-ticket%' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'at', service_name, count(*), min(time)::VARCHAR FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name LIKE '%ticket%' OR attr_k8s_pod_name LIKE 'ts-ticket%' OR span_name LIKE '%ticket%' GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT metric, service_name, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN value END),2) n_avg, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN value END),2) a_avg, round(max(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN value END),2) n_max, round(max(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN value END),2) a_max FROM (SELECT 'n' p,* FROM normal_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'a',* FROM abnormal_metrics) WHERE metric IN ('container.cpu.usage','container.memory.usage','jvm.cpu.recent_utilization','queueSize','k8s.pod.cpu_limit_utilization') AND service_name LIKE 'ts-%' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING abs(a_avg-n_avg) > 0.15*greatest(n_avg,0.01) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'n' p, span_name, count(*) c, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.9)/1e6,1) p90 FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', span_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,1), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.9)/1e6,1) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT 'a' p, service_name, level, left(message,90) msg, count(*) c FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level NOT IN ('INFO','DEBUG') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'n', service_name, level, left(message,90), count(*) FROM normal_logs WHERE level NOT IN ('INFO','DEBUG') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY c DESC
